messages:
jules_sales: Heads-up  Aurelia Systems asked for a Dedicated pool for a 6-week POC, want H100s in us-east4 if possible. Workload: Llama-2-70b-chat for customer-facing flows + Llama-2-13b for background tasks. Goal: ~45 concurrent chat sessions, p95 ~3s, token volume ~900k/day. Need VPC peering + 3 static egress IPs and customer-managed GCP KMS. Can we start with 4 H100 and allow burst to 7? Also need an initial ballpark for 6-week reserved pricing. Tagging infra/security. @tess_eng @mohit_infra @leo_se

ops-bot: Ticket created: DEDPOOL-4902 11: auto-assigned to infra.

tess_eng: Quick questions: are chats long-context multi-turn? typical session token length? Any strict latency for short prompts? Also will they accept a mixed-sku pool (13b on cheaper A100) for non-critical routes?

jules_sales: Multi-turn, avg ~800 tokens/session (history included). They insist on 70b for user-facing flows; 13b ok for background/reranks. For snappy prompts they'd like <400ms but understand p95 ~3s for heavy cases. Mixed-sku fallback is OK as long as routing guarantees 70b on H100 for priority routes.

mohit_infra: Ops note: one H100(80GB) practical concurrency for 70b chat with kv-cache & q4f16 ~10-14 sessions. 4xH100 -> ~40-56 concurrent depending on batching. Burst to 7 -> ~70-98. So 4 initial + autoscale/burst to 7 is reasonable. Need customer's VPC CIDR, desired number of static egress IPs (they asked for 3), and whether they need management-plane IP whitelist. Provisioning ETA ~48-96h after network info.

leo_se: Security checklist: request GCP KMS key resource name, whether key is in customer project, and if they require audit log ingestion (we can stream to their log sink). Need to confirm whether they want in-transit encryption only or disk encryption enforced with CMK (we support both). For POC we can accept platform-managed KMS if customer's CMK isn't ready but will flag as action item. Also confirm data residency requirements (EU vs US).

jules_sales: Customer provided CIDR: 10.50.0.0/16. They'll provide GCP KMS key by EOD tomorrow. They requested 3 static egress IPs. Billing contact: poc-billing@aurelia.com. No EU residency requirement for the POC. They'll sign a 6-week addendum.

tess_eng: Pricing note for sales: for short windows we usually prorate monthly reserved rate weekly and apply burst at on-demand + 25% premium. Rough example: reserved H100 ~ $13.5k/month (example), prorated for 6 weeks -> compute accordingly, burst billed on-demand. I'll ask finance for a tighter quote.

mohit_infra: Initial pool YAML I propose (replace placeholders):

```
pool_name: aurelia-poc-us-east4
region: us-east4
skus:
  - h100-80gb
initial_size: 4
max_burst_size: 7
routes:
  70b-chat:
    min_instances: 4
    preferred_sku: h100-80gb
  13b-ops:
    min_instances: 1
    preferred_sku: a100-40gb
    fallback: true
network:
  type: vpc-peering
  customer_cidr: 10.50.0.0/16
  static_egress_ips: [REPLACE_IP_1, REPLACE_IP_2, REPLACE_IP_3]
kms:
  provider: gcp-kms
  key_resource: projects/PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/key
quantization_profiles:
  70b-chat: q4f16
  13b-ops: q4_0
```

leo_se: Add to the checklist: enable audit log forwarding to customer's sink, create management-plane IP whitelist, and document CMK key rotation policy for the POC. Also ensure contract notes that logs may transit US for control-plane telemetry.

mohit_infra: Next steps: I'll raise the change DEDPOOL-4902 -> infra-review and set owner @mohit_infra. We need the KMS key name and network peer contact to proceed. Once approved provisioning time ~48-96h.

jules_sales: I'll follow up with the customer's cloud ops team for the KMS key and network contact now. Will update thread when they reply. Thanks all :heart:

ops-bot: DEDPOOL-4902 status: pending-infra-review -> assigned to mohit_infra. ETA updated.
